bio: Hello! My name is Danielle Geathers (she/her), and I’m a 1L at Harvard Law School. I’m originally from Miami, Florida and graduated from MIT in 2022, where I studied Mechanical Engineering with a focus on product development. After college, I worked at McKinsey & Company and joined the MIT Corporation as a recent graduate trustee. At MIT, I was involved in student government and developed a deep interest in educational equity and intellectual property, which continue to shape my path in law school. Outside the classroom, I love exploring new food spots around Boston, doing Pilates, and staying connected to my love for soccer. I’m so excited to meet you all!
